verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's pricing page lists "Advanced permissioning" (Pro) and "Advanced access control" (Enterprise) as product features, so some role-based restriction on who can change things exists. Nothing in the pack documents roles, per-flag or per-project permission scoping, or scoped management API tokens. Approval workflows and the read-only SDK endpoint are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented role and permission model, per-flag or per-project change scoping, scoped/least-privilege API tokens, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can restrict who can change which flags with roles, permissions, and scoped API tokens
